dessin: A data format sheet: one portrait sheet, proportions 2 by 3, flat pale #FBFCF8, with a 2 px ink outline and a second thin ink outline offset just outside it (a double frame), sharp corners. At the top, a header band about one sixth of the sheet height, separated from the body by one thin horizontal ink line across the full width; the header band is completely empty, plain pale. The whole body below is filled edge to edge with one regular pattern: a square grid of thin grey #7D8576 lines, evenly spaced, about twelve columns and eighteen rows of equal square cells, like graph paper. No map, no water, no relief, no symbol, no other color, nothing else.
